documents.text: AtlasQueue: recuperación verificada Una copia de seguridad no garantiza que el servicio pueda recuperarse. La prueba debe restaurar datos y comprobar su contenido. El manifiesto registra el checksum SHA-256 y la versión del esquema. Antes de restaurar, comprobar que ambos coinciden con el entorno de prueba. La retención de las copias es de treinta días. Mantener dos copias en ubicaciones diferentes evita depender de un único volumen. La restauración usa un directorio aislado. Nunca sobrescribir los datos de producción durante un ejercicio. Después de cargar la copia, reproducir el registro WAL hasta el punto acordado. Una escritura posterior no pertenece a ese snapshot. El informe guarda el identificador de la copia, la fecha y los resultados de las comprobaciones. Una ejecución sin errores no demuestra que falten cero registros. Si el checksum no coincide, detener la restauración y conservar el archivo para investigar. No sustituir el checksum esperado por el observado. El objetivo del ejercicio es detectar pérdidas y límites del procedimiento. Los tiempos locales no prometen el tiempo de recuperación de otro sistema. AtlasQueue | Página 1

config.scope: tokenizer only, no encoder inference or retrieval measurement

protocol.source: Frozen results/ledger.json canonical text. Controls and duplicate aliases excluded from indexing.

segmentation.alignment: Only sentence ends coinciding with canonical unit end may split; other ends are ignored and recorded. Split oversized sentence pieces by unit budget.

encoder.pooling: attention-mask weighted mean including active special tokens, raw float32

semantic.rule: Cut when distance>threshold or next piece would exceed budget; budget wins as primary reason; record both predicates. No relevance tuning.

overlap.rule: Step budget-overlap; keep final partial window; stop once a window reaches source end to avoid an entirely redundant tail.

retrieval.indexedText: chunk body only; no title enrichment or reranking
retrieval.statistics: Each partition gets its own BM25 index; changes to document frequency/length are part of the chunking effect.

evaluation.gold: Author-selected source spans with required fact groups; alternatives inside a group are acceptable equivalent sources. Queries/labels fixed before these rankings, already-known synthetic corpus, not blind test.
evaluation.coverage: For each fact,max fraction of required canonical unit IDs covered among its alternatives; query coverage=mean across facts; macro across answerable queries.
evaluation.complete: All fact groups have at least one fully covered alternative in the union of top3 chunks.
evaluation.redundancy: 1-unique retrieved canonical unit IDs / sum returned chunk units; zero with no returned context, report returned count too.
evaluation.negative: No gold facts means coverage/complete null, excluded from answerable aggregate; preserve every ranking, no calibrated abstention threshold.

protocol.selection: Retain all outputs,source hashes,negative and unchanged cases. Do not tune threshold,labels or retry selection based on metrics.
protocol.limits: Three short synthetic known documents,no production capacity claim,no comparison between different retrievers.

encoder.pooling: attention-mask weighted mean including active special tokens, raw float32

protocol.sources: original synthetic Spanish runbooks, no external documents or personal data

ocr.retries: one observation, no correction or best-run selection
ocr.confidence: engine score, not a calibrated probability of word correctness

layout.case: two columns with interleaved text drawing order
layout.limits: known-layout rule for controlled fixtures; not general document understanding

evaluation.truth: author-written source text before OCR, keep engine output unchanged
evaluation.cer: Levenshtein over NFC Unicode code points after whitespace folding; case preserved
evaluation.limits: synthetic clean scans, one OCR model, no production-quality claim

nextPhases.size: word-span windows with explicit UTF16 offsets, model-token preflight separately
nextPhases.semantic: real sentence embeddings, declared boundary and budget, no gold tuning
nextPhases.retrieval: same query gold across two strategies; include unanswerable and cross-boundary questions
